help:
usage: gnd evolve finalize [-h] --workspace WORKSPACE --records RECORDS
                           [--format {text,json}]
                           model pending

Load one immutable PENDING identity, finish its exact verbalization and
linked-project conformance leaves, and publish the final evolution record
last. Linked drift remains exit 13 with its raw evidence; no rollback or
regeneration occurs.

positional arguments:
  model                 published model file beneath ROOT
  pending               immutable pending-finalization JSON beneath ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        authoritative existing workspace ROOT
  --records RECORDS     authoritative immutable evidence DIR
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
